data.summary: ExperiencedServiceNowDeveloperwith4.5+yearsofexpertiseindesigning,developing,andimplementingITSMsolutions on the ServiceNow platform. Proficient in GlideRecord, GlideSystem, Update Sets, CMDB, server-side and client-side scripting, and REST/SOAP integrations. Skilled in configuring modules, building Service Catalogs, automating workflows using Flow Designer, and optimizing processes to improve efficiency and user experience. Experienced in working with Agile/Scrum methodologies and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver solutions on time. Holds four ServiceNow certi- fications including CIS-ITSM and CIS-CSM. Recognized for strong problem-solving and communication skills, consistently delivering high-quality results and driving measurable business outcomes.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
ExperiencedServiceNowDeveloperwith4.5+yearsofexpertiseindesigning,developing,andimplementingITSMsolutions on the ServiceNow platform. Proficient in GlideRecord, GlideSystem, Update Sets, CMDB, server-side and client-side scripting, and REST/SOAP integrations. Skilled in configuring modules, building Service Catalogs, automating workflows using Flow Designer, and optimizing processes to improve efficiency and user experience. Experienced in working with Agile/Scrum methodologies and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver solutions on time. Holds four ServiceNow certi- fications including CIS-ITSM and CIS-CSM. Recognized for strong problem-solving and communication skills, consistently delivering high-quality results and driving measurable business outcomes.
raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
ServiceNow Development • ServiceNow Scripting • ITSM Modules(Incident,Problem,Change,Request,etc.) • Workflows and Flow Designers • JavaScript • Configuring SLAs and ACLs • Troubleshooting and Debugging • REST and SOAP Integrations • GlideRecord and GlideSystem APIs • CMDB (Configuration Management Database)
Update Sets and Deployment Management • Service Catalog Management • Change Management • Agile / Scrum Methodology • MID Server Configuration • ServiceNow Administration • Data Sources, Transform Maps and Import Sets • Email Notifications and Inbound Actions • Performance Analytics and Dashboards • UI Policies, UI Actions, Data Policies & Script Includes
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Analyst | Capgemini (Oct 2021–Present)
Delivered 4.5+ years of ServiceNow development expertise, building scalable ITSM solutions across enterprise environ- ments.
Designed and automated workflows using Flow Designer, reducing manual effort and accelerating process execution by 40%.
Engineered server-side and client-side scripts using JavaScript, GlideRecord, and GlideSystem APIs, improving appli- cation performance and data retrieval efficiency.
Partnered with stakeholders following Agile/Scrum methodology to gather requirements and deliver solutions on time, earning consistent client recognition.
Streamlined data management by leveraging Data Sources, Transform Maps, and Import Sets, ensuring 99%+ data
accuracy.
Expertise in troubleshooting and debugging ServiceNow issues/bugs, resulting in a 30% reduction in downtime and improved user satisfaction scores.
Managed end-to-end Update Set creation, testing, and production deployments, ensuring zero-defect releases. • Designed and published Performance Analytics dashboards and database views, enabling real-time visibility for stake- holders.
Automated recurring tasks with Scheduled Jobs, Export Sets, and scripts, improving operational efficiency. • Directed key enhancements and production rollouts, ensuring smooth deployments and minimal disruption to services.
Senior ServiceNow Developer | Baker Hughes (Jan 2022– Present)
Served as ServiceNow Developer and Administrator, leading ITSM and ITAM initiatives to deliver enterprise-grade so- lutions across a large-scale energy sector client.
Led ITSM module requirements and issue resolution, ensuring timely delivery and effective client support across Inci- dent, Change, and Request processes.
Implemented Incident Management, Problem Management, and Service Request Management processes, streamlin- ing workflows and reducing resolution times.
Developed UI Policies, UI Actions, and Script Includes to enhance system functionality and user experience. • Built workflows, business rules, client scripts, ACLs, and REST/SOAP integrations to automate processes and improve operational efficiency.
• UtilizedGlideRecordandGlideSystemAPIsforcomplexserver-sidescripting,improvingdataretrievalperformanceand
application reliability.
Maintained CMDB accuracy through regular audits and data reconciliation using Discovery and Import Sets. • Configured and maintained MID Server to facilitate secure communication between the ServiceNow instance and en- terprise network, supporting integrations and data collection activities.
Migrated legacy homepages into Performance Analytics dashboards, improving usability and reporting accuracy for stakeholders.
Managedend-to-endUpdateSetcreation,testing,andproductiondeployments,ensuringsmoothrolloutswithminimal disruption to services.
Delivered integrations and data migrations, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy across enterprise sys- tems.
Built Service Catalog items and automated flows with Flow Designer and Workflows, aligning with client requirements. • AutomatedreportingthroughExportSets,improvingvisibilityandreducingmanualreportingtasksbysignificantmargin. • Developed and optimized server-side and client-side scripts to meet evolving business needs using GlideRecord, Busi- ness Rules, and Fix Scripts.
Managed ServiceNow Administration tasks including account creation, roles, groups, and access control. • Imported data from Excel into ServiceNow using Data Sources and Transform Maps with high accuracy. • FollowedAgile/Scrummethodology,participatinginsprintplanning,dailystandups,andretrospectiveswithclientstake- holders.
Automated daily data uploads via workflows and business rules, eliminating manual intervention. • DevelopedFixScriptsandScriptIncludestohandlecomplexbackendlogicandsupportevolvingbusinessrequirements. • Configured email notifications, templates, and inbound actions to improve communication efficiency across teams.
